intro.en: Chen Qianyu is a core member of Endfield Industries' Crisis Team who trained in martial arts from childhood, travelled Talos-II alone for several years, and joined at Perlica's invitation.
intro.zh-TW: 陳千語是終末地工業危機處理小組的核心成員，自幼習武並獨自遊歷塔衛二數年，後受佩麗卡邀請加入終末地。

basic.en: Physical combo of up to 5 hits. While she is the controlled operator, her Final Strike also deals 16 Stagger.
basic.zh-TW: 最多 5 段的物理傷害連擊。作為主控幹員時，重擊會額外造成 16 點失衡。

battle.en: Performs an uppercut slash at the target, dealing Physical damage and applying Lift.
battle.zh-TW: 對目標發動上挑斬擊，造成物理傷害並附加擊飛。

combo.en: Trigger: an enemy becomes Vulnerable. She dashes through the target with a slash, dealing Physical damage and Lift to every enemy in her path.
combo.zh-TW: 觸發條件：有敵人進入破防狀態。穿梭斬擊目標，對路徑上的所有敵人造成物理傷害並附加擊飛。

ultimate.en: Unleashes a 7-hit slash combo on the target for Physical damage, with the final slash dealing heavier damage.
ultimate.zh-TW: 對目標發動 7 段斬擊造成物理傷害，最後一段的傷害更高。

talents.en: Hitting an enemy with a skill grants Chen Qianyu +4% ATK (+8% at Promotion II) for 10 s, stacking up to 5 times.
talents.zh-TW: 技能每次命中敵人後，自身攻擊力 +4%（精英化II 為 +8%），持續 10 秒，最多疊加 5 層。

talents.en: Interrupting an enemy's charge-up deals an extra 5 Stagger (10 at Promotion III).
talents.zh-TW: 技能打斷敵人蓄力時，額外造成 5 點失衡（精英化III 為 10 點）。

potentials.en: Deals +20% damage to enemies below 50% HP.
potentials.zh-TW: 對生命值低於 50% 的敵人造成的傷害 +20%。

potentials.en: Ascending Strike, Soar to the Stars, and Blade Gale deal 1.1 times their damage.
potentials.zh-TW: 歸穹宇、見天河與冽風霜的傷害倍率提升為 1.1 倍。

potentials.en: Blade Gale costs 15% less Ultimate Energy.
potentials.zh-TW: 冽風霜所需的終結技能量 -15%。

potentials.en: Soar to the Stars has its cooldown reduced by 3 s.
potentials.zh-TW: 見天河的冷卻時間減少 3 秒。
